title: Encounter
description: One entry of an encounter table (03-GAME-DESIGN §11.1 step 4, §11.2): a monster composition written for three players; the sim scales count and HP by party size. One file per encounter under content/encounters/<id>.json; a floor picks from all entries sharing its encounterTableId whose floorBand covers the floor.

tableId.description: The table this entry belongs to; floors reference it by encounterTableId.

floorBand.description: Floors (not monster levels) this entry can appear on.

composition.description: Monsters at three players; 2–6 in total before scaling.

weight.description: Relative pick weight within the table.

ambushModifier.description: Added to the surprise roll in percentage points (§4.4: ambusher families +15).

eliteAllowed.description: Whether this composition may fill an Elite room with affixes applied to its elite-role monster.
